alt: Three paper craft shapes resembling the icons for Word (blue with a W), Excel (green with an X), and PowerPoint (orange with a P) sit on a black surface near pink and orange paper rolls.
caption: Paper craft icons for Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint arranged on a dark surface with rolls of colored paper.
description: This image displays three stylized paper craft icons representing the Microsoft Office applications Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Each icon is made from colored paper, with the letters W, X, and P printed on the front, set against a dark background with other crafting supplies like folded paper and paper rolls.
